private theorem relationReadMultipleWitness_mul_pureS (n : Nat) (x : G(n + 1))
    (a : HS) {c : B}
    (hc : RelationReadMultipleWitness (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x c) :
    RelationReadMultipleWitness (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
        (divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side 0
            (divUniversalPureWindowZeroTensor (C := C) (pi := pi)
              hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j a) * c) := by

    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (m + 1) (1 ⊗ₜ a) y
  have hy' : y' ∈ (K(m + 2)) :=
    map_divUniversalHighWindowTensorMultiplierTransition_relation_succ_le
      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j m (1 ⊗ₜ a) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.le.step hnm, y', ?_, ?_⟩

/-- Every pure arithmetic-progression coefficient eventually multiplies a
recursive relation reading. -/
private theorem exists_relationReadMultipleWitness_pureWindow (q n : Nat)
    (z : RZ ⊗[k] HP(q)) (x : G(n + 1)) (hx : x ∈ (K(n + 1))) :
    RelationReadMultipleWitness (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
        (divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side q z) := by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      let z0 : RZ ⊗[k] HS := by
        exact LinearMap.baseChange RZ
          (divisorWindowExponentEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi)
            (by simp : S + 0 * S = S)).toLinearMap z
      let y := divUniversalHighWindowTensorMultiplierTransition
        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) z0 x
      have hy : y ∈ (K(n + 2)) :=
        map_divUniversalHighWindowTensorMultiplierTransition_relation_succ_le
          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n z0 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨n + 1, Nat.le_succ n, y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd] using hy
      · rw [divUniversalHighWindowTensorMultiplierTransition_chartRead]
        rw [divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead_zero]
  | succ q ih =>
      induction z with
      | zero =>
          simpa only [map_zero] using
            relationReadMultipleWitness_zero (C := C) (pi := pi)
              hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
      | add z w hz hw =>
          simpa only [map_add] using
            relationReadMultipleWitness_add (C := C) (pi := pi)
              hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x hz hw
      | tmul r a =>
          let T := Scheme.divisorSections k ((S + (q + 1) * S) • F) ⊤
          let P : C.left.functionField → Prop := fun w =>
            ∀ hw : w ∈ T,
              RelationReadMultipleWitness (C := C) (pi := pi)
                hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
                  (divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
                    hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side (q + 1) (1 ⊗ₜ ⟨w, hw⟩))
          have hspan := thetaCoordinate_windowS_mulSpan_eq
            (C := C) pi hpi g q
          have ha : (a : C.left.functionField) ∈
              Scheme.mulSpan k
                (Scheme.divisorSections k (S • F) ⊤)
                (Scheme.divisorSections k ((S + q * S) • F) ⊤) := by
            rw [hspan]
            exact a.property
          have hpa : ∀ (w : C.left.functionField),
              w ∈ Scheme.mulSpan k
                (Scheme.divisorSections k (S • F) ⊤)
                (Scheme.divisorSections k ((S + q * S) • F) ⊤) → P w := by
            intro w hwspan
            induction hwspan using Submodule.span_induction with
            | mem w hw =>
                obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hw
                intro hab
                let a' : HS := ⟨a, ha⟩
                let b' : HP(q) := ⟨b, hb⟩
                have hpure := ih (1 ⊗ₜ b')
                have hmul := relationReadMultipleWitness_mul_pureS
                  (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x a' hpure
                have hprod : (⟨a * b, hab⟩ : HP(q + 1)) =
                    divUniversalPureWindowProduct (C := C) (pi := pi)
                      hpi g q a' b' := by
                  apply Subtype.ext
                  simp only [coe_divUniversalPureWindowProduct, a', b']
                rw [hprod, divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead_product]
                exact hmul
            | zero =>
                intro hzero
                have hzero' : (⟨0, hzero⟩ : HP(q + 1)) = 0 := by
                  apply Subtype.ext
                  rfl
                rw [hzero', TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
                exact relationReadMultipleWitness_zero (C := C) (pi := pi)
                  hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
            | add v w hv hw hvw hww =>
                intro hvaddw
                have hvT : v ∈ T := by
                  change v ∈ Scheme.divisorSections k
                    ((S + (q + 1) * S) • F) ⊤
                  rw [← hspan]
                  exact hv
                have hwT : w ∈ T := by
                  change w ∈ Scheme.divisorSections k
                    ((S + (q + 1) * S) • F) ⊤
                  rw [← hspan]
                  exact hw
                change RelationReadMultipleWitness (C := C) (pi := pi)
                  hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x
                    (divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
                      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side (q + 1)
                        (1 ⊗ₜ ⟨v + w, hvaddw⟩))
                have hadd : (⟨v + w, hvaddw⟩ : HP(q + 1)) =
                    ⟨v, hvT⟩ + ⟨w, hwT⟩ := by
                  apply Subtype.ext
                  rfl
                rw [hadd, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
                exact relationReadMultipleWitness_add (C := C) (pi := pi)
                  hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x (hvw hvT) (hww hwT)
            | smul c v hv hvw =>
                intro hcv
                have hvT : v ∈ T := by
                  change v ∈ Scheme.divisorSections k
                    ((S + (q + 1) * S) • F) ⊤
                  rw [← hspan]
                  exact hv
                have hsmul : (⟨c • v, hcv⟩ : HP(q + 1)) =
                    c • (⟨v, hvT⟩ : HP(q + 1)) := by
                  apply Subtype.ext
                  rfl
                have htensor :
                    (1 ⊗ₜ (⟨c • v, hcv⟩ : HP(q + 1)) : RZ ⊗[k] HP(q + 1)) =
                      algebraMap k RZ c • (1 ⊗ₜ (⟨v, hvT⟩ : HP(q + 1))) := by
                  rw [hsmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
                  exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul RZ c _).symm
                rw [htensor, map_smul]
                exact relationReadMultipleWitness_smul (C := C) (pi := pi)
                  hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x (algebraMap k RZ c) (hvw hvT)
          have hpure := hpa (a : C.left.functionField) ha a.property
          have htmul : (r ⊗ₜ a : RZ ⊗[k] HP(q + 1)) =
              r • (1 ⊗ₜ a) := by
            rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          rw [htmul, map_smul]
          exact relationReadMultipleWitness_smul (C := C) (pi := pi)
            hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x r hpure
